subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Which public WhatsApp sticker-send contract and encoding policy should OpenClaw support before implementation?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing between `action=sticker`, an option such as `asSticker`, automatic WebP detection, and sticker validation affects user-facing behavior and compatibility.

options.title: Use Explicit Sticker Intent
options.body: Expose `action=sticker` or an explicit WhatsApp send option and route media as stickers only when that intent is present.

options.title: Use WebP Heuristics
options.body: Treat qualifying WebP media as stickers automatically, accepting misclassification and encoding-policy risk for ordinary WebP image sends.

options.title: Defer Public Feature
options.body: Keep only the low-level helper and inbound sticker handling until a broader cross-channel sticker contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Use Explicit Sticker Intent
recommendation.body: Expose `action=sticker` or an explicit WhatsApp send option and route media as stickers only when that intent is present.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the strongest recent history on the structured WhatsApp send helper adjacent to the missing public contract.
